svg.title: Icon sheet
svg.desc: 50 original icons on a 24px grid: 1.75px stroke, round caps and joins, 2px live-area padding. Outline by default; the like heart fills when active. · Wake, A Glance-inspired design system. Original vector artwork; not a Glance asset.
svg.text: 50 original icons on a 24px grid: 1.75px stroke, round caps and joins, 2px
live-area padding. Outline by default; the like heart fills when active.
Wake · A Glance-inspired design system · v1.0
· 1.75px stroke at 24px; stroke is compensated so 16px and 20px icons keep the same optical weight
· Round caps and joins; corners use 1–1.5px radii
· Filled only for active state (like) and play
· Icon colour follows text colour; iris for personalisation, signal only when live
